title: [finding] fresh starters carry a latent `field-no-consumers` warning that the first `os generate` wakes (create-objectstack blank `note.body`; `os init -t app` item `description` / `status`)
body:
Source: the os-dev report on #21325 (`5947877777`, PR #21369), `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a. Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_01VvcEokUG1tvVxkceYfR5XB`.

## What happens (measured, public door)

1. `npm create objectstack tasks-app` (the in-repo on-ramp bin), then `os g dashboard sales`, then `os validate`: exit 0 with one warning, `field-no-consumers` at `objects[0].fields.body`. That is the starter's own `tasks_app_note.body`, which the author never touched.
2. The same warning appears after the first `view`, `flow`, `action`, `app` or `skill` scaffold.
3. `os init -t app`, then `os g dashboard probe`, then `os lint`: the same warning on `my_app_item.description` and `my_app_item.status`.

A bare starter with no `os g` reports 0 findings. The warning appears only once something consumes the stack.

## Why

The rule stays silent while a stack holds no consumer root. Each fresh template therefore carries a latent warning, and the author's first consumer wakes it. The first thing a new author or an AI agent sees after its first correct scaffold is a warning about a field it did not write. That teaches it to ignore warnings, or to "fix" the template.

## Where the fix lands

- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/objects/note.object.ts`;
- the `app` entry of `TEMPLATES` in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`.

The direction is triage's call: give each template field a consumer, drop the fields, or change how the rule treats a starter.

## Pin hand-off

PR #21369 (#21325) adds `packages/cli/test/generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts`. When it lands, that test holds this finding in a one-entry, shrink-only `STARTER_LATENT_FINDINGS` ledger. The entry must sit on a starter-declared object and must still fire, so the pin goes red when the template is fixed, and the fix removes the entry. Until #21369 lands, the ledger exists only on that PR.

Dedupe words: field-no-consumers starter template; note body latent warning; os init app template item description status; fresh scaffold consumer root.
